explanation: The theorem says that the spatial Fréchet derivative of a flow X of a smooth periodic vector field b on Vec 2 is continuous in x. Its content rests on the library's own definitions (`SmoothPeriodicField`, `AVenhance.IsFlow`). The proof uses only library lemmas: the case s ≤ t comes from `flow_spatialFDeriv_continuous_of_le`, and the case t ≤ s reduces to it by time reversal. I did not grep Mathlib for this theorem; the verdict comes from reading the proof and from general knowledge of Mathlib. Its ODE files (Mathlib/Analysis/ODE: Picard–Lindelöf, Gronwall) cover existence and uniqueness of solutions. As far as I know, they have no result on continuity, in the initial condition, of the derivative of a flow, and no single Mathlib declaration specializes to this statement.
